title: tern-kube config
description: Settings of tern-kube, the Kubernetes plugin for Tern: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tern-kube/config.json (default ~/.config/tern-kube/config.json). Every key is optional; a bad value falls back to its default with a diagnostic. https://github.com/contrafy/tern-kube/blob/master/docs/configuration.md

$schema.description: JSON Schema of this file, for editor completion and validation; tern-kube ignores it

schema_version.description: Version of this file's format; kept by tern-kube

general.description: Native views, capture limits and the login-shell environment

native_default.description: Native views for lensed kubectl output; off shows Tern's raw output

max_rows.description: Output lines recorded for a native view; more falls back to raw

max_rendered_rows.description: Rows drawn at once (lens pages, Explore windows)

max_capture_bytes.description: Output bytes captured per command; more falls back to raw

shell_env.description: Read PATH and KUBECONFIG from your login shell (once per Tern daemon) so kubectl, helm, gh and credential plugins are found when Tern starts from the Dock or Finder

streaming_view.description: What the lens shows while logs -f or an events watch still runs; native trails the stream

additional.description: Alias names you intend to claim (informational; scripts/tern-kube-aliases writes the claims)

allow_live_queries.description: Off: Explore opens but runs no kubectl command

auto_refresh.description: Only false is supported: Explore never polls

query_timeout_ms.description: Each Explore kubectl call is killed after this many ms

relationship_max_nodes.description: Objects in a relations graph before it is truncated

logs_tail.description: Lines the Explore logs view fetches (--tail)

mutations.description: Previews and confirmations for every guarded change

enabled.description: Off hides every mutating action; the approve block refuses

interactive_guard.description: Marks the opt-in shell guard as wanted (installed separately)

require_target_confirmation.description: Mutations need a named or confirmed context, never an inferred one

allow_failed_preview_override.description: Allow confirming when the dry run or diff failed

preview_timeout_ms.description: Each preview step is killed after this many ms

execute_timeout_ms.description: A confirmed mutation is killed after this many ms

show_secret_values.description: Show Secret values in native views (trusted screens only)

sensitive_output_strict_mode.description: Also mask values whose names look sensitive (heuristic)

quick_actions.description: Shell, logs, port-forward and debug terminals

shell_command.description: Program and arguments the Shell action runs in the container
default: command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec bash || exec sh

logs_tail.description: History lines the Logs action shows before following

debug_image.description: Image for debug containers and node debug pods

kubectl.description: kubectl program: an absolute path, or a name looked up on your shell's PATH, common install dirs, then Tern's PATH

kubeconfig.description: Kubeconfig for Explore links that name none (absolute path; empty = unset)

gitops.description: Manifest index, diff, drift and export

helm.description: Helm releases for diff and drift: [{chart, release, namespace?, values?}]

unmanaged_kinds.description: Kinds the drift report checks for unmanaged objects (empty = the source's kinds)

max_bytes.description: Total bytes read per manifest scan

render_kustomize.description: Render kustomizations while indexing so overlays map to live names

gh.description: GitHub CLI for the optional pull request step: an absolute path, or a name looked up like kubectl's

helm.description: Helm releases in Explore and rollbacks through the approve block

program.description: helm program: an absolute path, or a name looked up like kubectl's

driver.description: Release storage helm reads (HELM_DRIVER); must match how the releases were installed

list_max.description: Releases Explore lists at once (helm list --max)

history_max.description: Revisions Explore reads per release (helm history --max)

auto_detect.description: Offer chart directories in the repository as drift sources for matching releases

chart_sources.description: Where pristine chart defaults come from when a release's stored ones are unusable: [{chart, ref}]

rollback_wait.description: Rollbacks wait for the rolled-back objects to be ready (--wait)

rollback_wait_for_jobs.description: With rollback_wait, also wait for Jobs to complete (--wait-for-jobs)

rollback_cleanup_on_fail.description: Delete objects a failed rollback created (--cleanup-on-fail)

rollback_timeout_s.description: Rollback --timeout in seconds (also bounds hooks); keep it 30 s under mutations.execute_timeout_ms
